excerpt: Two thirds of your land is forest, and you renew more fresh water per person than almost any nation in Africa.
paras: Two thirds of your land is forest, and you renew more fresh water per person than almost any nation in Africa. One in three of you has electricity. Let the forest and the water carry the capital that brings power, schools and clinics to every county.

Your partners are working beside you. In April 2026 the International Monetary Fund added a Resilience and Sustainability Facility to the programme it approved in 2024. In June 2026 the World Bank approved $55.8 million of budget support, and you signed $57 million for emergency solar power and $18 million for the roads of the southeast.

The work ahead is plain, and it is worth saying plainly. Only one in every hundred of you cooks with clean fuel, and about one in three has electricity. Seventy-nine in every hundred of you cannot always count on enough good food. Sixty-one in every hundred of your city dwellers live in slums. Clean energy sets your Coverage today, at 1 out of 100, with food and shelter close behind. Each of them is within your reach.

Now imagine that same resolve turned toward every home in the country. Picture Perfect Liberia: a morning when every family cooks with clean fuel and sits down to a full table; when every tap runs clean and every home has a safe toilet; when every child walks to a school where a teacher is waiting, and reads with ease by the age of ten; when every mother lives within reach of a clinic with the lights on, and every young person finds work that pays. And no Liberian falls below a decent life, because the nation has decided that none will.
quote: The rainforest that shelters you can also pay for the light in every home.
